metadata.title: COSU Student Assessment Devices (Non‑Exam) SSPP
metadata.remarks: System Security and Privacy Plan defining Corporate-Owned Single-Use (COSU) Student Assessment Devices used for low-stakes, non-exam instructional assessment activities.

import-profile.remarks: Institutional security and privacy baseline profile.

system-characteristics.system-description: A corporate-owned, single-use endpoint dedicated to supporting low-stakes instructional assessment activities such as quizzes, polling, and attendance, without general-purpose computing capability.

props.name: inherits-from-sspp
props.remarks: COSU Student Assessment Devices inherit foundational endpoint trust governance from the Secure Endpoint Platform SSPP.

props.name: endpoint-class
props.remarks: Single-use COSU endpoint for non-exam instructional assessment.

props.name: execution-model
props.remarks: Execution is restricted to approved assessment, polling, and response applications.

props.name: user-authentication-model
props.remarks: Students authenticate per session; no persistent local user accounts are retained.

props.name: ownership-model
props.remarks: Student Assessment Devices are owned by the institution.

props.name: management-model
props.remarks: Student Assessment Devices are centrally enrolled, configured, monitored, and reset.

props.name: cryptographic-identity
props.remarks: Device identity is used for management integrity and secure communication with assessment platforms.

props.name: baseline-hardening
props.remarks: Operating system configuration disables general productivity tools, web browsing (unless required), removable media, and unauthorized applications.

props.name: session-isolation
props.remarks: Each assessment session is isolated and cleared upon completion or timeout.

props.name: anti-cheating-controls
props.remarks: Basic controls limit application switching and unintended assistance, without the full enforcement required for high-stakes exams.

props.name: network-access-model
props.remarks: Network access is limited to approved learning management systems, assessment services, and management endpoints.

props.name: data-persistence
props.remarks: Assessment responses must not be stored locally beyond transient, encrypted in-memory use.

props.name: eligible-data-classifications
props.remarks: Student Assessment Devices may handle minimal instructional assessment data only.

props.name: non-equivalence-statement
props.remarks: Non-exam assessment devices do not provide exam-grade integrity or eligibility for higher-trust assessment workflows.

props.name: availability-requirement
props.remarks: Student Assessment Devices must prioritize uptime and rapid recovery to support instructional activities.

props.name: monitoring-and-integrity-signals
props.remarks: Device health, configuration drift, misuse attempts, and session lifecycle events are continuously monitored.

props.name: lifecycle-governance
props.remarks: Student Assessment Devices support automated reset, periodic reimage, and auditable retirement workflows.

system-implementation.remarks: COSU Student Assessment Devices implement Secure Endpoint patterns with emphasis on instructional utility, session isolation, and low-risk assessment integrity.

roles.title: Instructional Operations
roles.remarks: Responsible for deployment, configuration, and classroom use of Student Assessment Devices.

roles.title: Academic Governance
roles.remarks: Defines acceptable use, assessment scope, and eligibility for non-exam assessment devices.

roles.title: Endpoint Security Operations
roles.remarks: Ensures security posture, monitoring, and lifecycle governance for Student Assessment Devices.

control-implementation.remarks: Student Assessment Device implementations may use kiosk-mode operating systems or dedicated assessment platforms and are maintained as controlled, versioned configuration baselines.
